trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّ الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالرُّوْحِ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّ الرُّوْحِ وَالْعَرْشِ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْاَرَضِيْنَ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ رَبُّ الْبِحَارِ وَالْجِبَالِ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ الْحِيْتَانُ وَالْهَوَامُ وَالسِّبَاعُ فِي الْآكَامِ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ سَبَّحَتْ لَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْمُقَرَّبُوْنَ، سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ عَلَا فَقَهَرَ وَخَلَقَ فَقَدَرَ، سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ سُبُّوْحٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ قُدُّوْسٌ اِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّعَلٰى آلِهٖ وَ اغْفِرْ لِيْ وَارْحَمْنِيْ، حَقَّا اَنْتَ الْاَبْدِي الْمُطَلَقً۔

lines.rarabic: SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON RABBUL MALAA-E-KATE WAR-ROOHE, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON RABBUR ROOHE WAL-A’R-SHE, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON RABBUS SAMAA-WAATE WAL-ARA-ZEENA, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON RABBUL BE-HAARE WAL JEBAA-LE, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON YO-SABBE-HO LAHUL HEE-TAANO WAL-HAWAA-MO WAS-SEBAA-O’ FIL-AA-KAAME, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON SABBA-HAT LAHUL MALAA-E-KATUL MO-QARRA-BOONA, SUBBOO-HOON QUDDOO-SOON A’LAA FA-QAHARA WA KHALAQA FA-QADARA, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, SUBBOO-HOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON, QUDDOO-SOON INNA-KA ANTAL GHAFOO-RUR RAHEEMO SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA A’LAA AALE-HI WAGH-FIR-LEE WAR-HAMNEE, HAQQAA ANTAL ABDIL MOTA-LAQAN.

trans.en: Sacred Holy Lord of the angels and the Spirit! Sacred Holy Lord of the Spirit and the Throne! Sacred Holy Lord of the heavens and the earths! Sacred Holy Lord of the seas and the mountains! Sacred Holy whom the fish, the pests and the beasts in the jungles glorify. Sacred Holy whom the nearby-stationed angels glorify. Sacred Holy He is Sublime thus subdues. Creates thus He is Powerful! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Sacred! Holy! Holy! Holy! Holy! Holy! Holy! Holy! Surely you are the best forgiver I ask You to bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s), forgive me and have Mercy on me. Indeed You are the One! The Eternal, Absolute!
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
